evals.expected_output: Review should identify: (1) Warning - JSON.stringify comparison in useEffect is expensive and unreliable (reference equality issues, missing initialValues in deps), (2) Warning - reset() has stale closure on initialValues (missing in deps), (3) Warning - handleSubmit doesn't handle errors from onSubmit (no try/catch, isSubmitting stays true if throws), (4) Warning - isTouched tracks any field touched but not which field, limiting usefulness, (5) Suggestion - Record<string, any> types could be more precise with generics, (6) Suggestion - submitCount is rarely useful API surface
assertions: The review flags the JSON.stringify comparison as problematic (expensive or dep array issue)
The review identifies that reset() will close over stale initialValues
The review flags missing error handling in handleSubmit (no try/catch)
The review mentions the any types as worth improving
The review includes a verdict / recommendation

evals.expected_output: Review should identify major accessibility problems: (1) Critical/Accessibility - no role='dialog' or aria-modal='true', (2) Critical/Accessibility - no focus trap (keyboard users can tab behind the modal), (3) Accessibility - close button is a span with onClick, not a button - not keyboard accessible, (4) Accessibility - no aria-labelledby connecting title to dialog, (5) Accessibility - Escape key not handled, (6) Warning - no focus management (focus should move into modal on open, return to trigger on close), (7) Suggestion - inline styles vs CSS classes
assertions: The review identifies missing role='dialog' or aria-modal attribute
The review flags the lack of focus trapping
The review flags the span close button as inaccessible (not a button element)
The review mentions Escape key handling as missing
The review mentions focus management (returning focus on close)
